scope: Fictional deterministic simulation; automated checks do not validate learning or historical binding

checks.name: Internal and supplier plans both work in the ordinary control
Bay placement changes physical handoff, concentrated staffing can miss a reservation
Returned funding restores cash but not settlement; saved Tuesday label remains
New payment requires authority, debits only once, and closes on recipient confirmation
Substitute can protect delivery while the original obligation remains reserved
Routine batch is one debit; its allocations are not additional cash movements
Rejected transitions do not mutate state; action replay recreates the complete run
